stem.text: An object of mass $0.40\,\text{kg}$ is projected into the air and follows a curved path above horizontal ground.

stem.alt: Curved path of an object launched from horizontal ground, labelled path of object, with an arrow at the object's position and a horizontal distance of 18 m between the launch and landing points.

stem.text: The object takes a time of $1.5\,\text{s}$ to move along its path. The object lands a horizontal distance of $18\,\text{m}$ from its initial position. Air resistance is negligible.
What is the kinetic energy of the object at its maximum height?
